candidate.claim: parseLocale fallback for hyphenated locales drops isLocal/object and recurses without them, so a local lookup can mutate the global locale L.
candidate.title: Locale fallback loses isLocal flag

verifier.reason: Recursion at index.js:28 calls parseLocale(presetSplit[0]) without isLocal/object, so a local call such as index.js:87 with isLocal=true recurses with isLocal undefined and reaches index.js:35 where L is mutated.

candidate.claim: Duration ISO string parsing slices from group 2 onward and never applies the leading -/+ sign captured in group 1, so negative durations parse as positive.
candidate.title: Duration ISO leading sign ignored

verifier.reason: The regex at plugin/duration/index.js:12 captures the leading sign in group 1, but parsing at plugin/duration/index.js:86 uses d.slice(2) and maps those values directly to the duration fields without applying d[1], so a leading '-' is discarded and negative durations parse as positive.

candidate.claim: Adding/subtracting a Duration to a Dayjs drops the weeks component because manipulateDuration never adds weeks.

evidence.snippet:
const manipulateDuration = (date, duration, k) =>
  date.add(duration.years() * k, 'y')
    .add(duration.months() * k, 'M')
    .add(duration.days() * k, 'd')
    .add(duration.hours() * k, 'h')
    .add(duration.minutes() * k, 'm')
    .add(duration.seconds() * k, 's')
    .add(duration.milliseconds() * k, 'ms')

candidate.title: Duration weeks omitted when adding to date

verifier.reason: manipulateDuration at plugin/duration/index.js:261-268 adds years, months, days, hours, minutes, seconds and milliseconds but no weeks, while weeks() is a distinct accessor at plugin/duration/index.js:253-254 separate from days() at plugin/duration/index.js:251-252, and Dayjs add/subtract delegate duration inputs to it at plugin/duration/index.js:282-295.

candidate.claim: utc valueOf uses || for $localOffset, so a stored local offset of 0 is treated as falsy and replaced with getTimezoneOffset, producing a wrong timestamp.
candidate.title: UTC valueOf falsy handling of zero offset

verifier.reason: The code at plugin/utc/index.js:121 uses (this.$x.$localOffset || this.$d.getTimezoneOffset()), so a stored 0 from plugin/utc/index.js:107 is falsy and replaced by getTimezoneOffset(), changing addedOffset and the returned timestamp at plugin/utc/index.js:122 when that value differs.

candidate.claim: offsetFromString does not default missing minutes, so hour-only offsets like +02 produce NaN instead of 120 minutes.
candidate.title: Hour-only UTC offset parses to NaN

candidate.claim: Fractional seconds are truncated to 3 chars without scaling, so .5 becomes 5ms instead of 500ms and .56 becomes 56ms instead of 560ms.
candidate.title: Millisecond fraction not scaled to milliseconds
